zh.text: James E. Thorne 回覆 @vexor4i：當通脹下降時，維持利率不變按定義即是緊縮。

en.text: James E. Thorne replies to @vexor4i: When inflation falls, keeping rates steady by definition is tightening.

zh.text: First Squawk：IMF 的 Georgieva 表示全球通脹上升增加多個經濟體貨幣政策緊縮的必要性。

en.text: First Squawk: IMF's Georgieva says higher global inflation is increasing the need for monetary policy tightening across multiple economies.

zh.text: 週一，舊金山聯邦儲備銀行、Warsh主席和聯邦儲備委員會舉辦了生產力和就業工作組會議。

en.text: On Monday, the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Chairman Warsh, and the Federal Reserve Board hosted the Productivity and Jobs Task Force Conference.

zh.text: J.C. Parets 問連看淡市場與衰退來臨的人是否也去 Cheesecake Factory。

en.text: J.C. Parets asks if even the bear market and recession coming people go to the Cheesecake Factory.

zh.text: $IWM 搭配 $TNX 10 年期收益率下降看起來更好？相對便宜的隱含波動率及低風險反轉。@spotgamma 圖表是快速判斷策略是否穩健的好工具。

en.text: $IWM with $TNX 10yr fading looking better? relatively cheap IV and low risk reversal. @spotgamma graphic - a nice tool to tell you quickly if your strategy is solid.

zh.text: juan_gonzalesP 指出 @robin_j_brooks 剛剛標誌了宏觀中最重要的脫鉤：美元正在飆升，但它沒有追蹤利率差異。這是信用事件信號，不是利率交易。

en.text: juan_gonzalesP notes @robin_j_brooks just flagged the most important decoupling in macro: the dollar is surging, but it is NOT tracking rate differentials. This is a credit event signal, not a rates trade.

zh.text: First Squawk：布倫特原油期貨上漲 1.08 美元至每桶 93.03 美元。

en.text: First Squawk: Brent crude futures edge higher by $1.08 to $93.03/bbl.

zh.text: X上每個人都在提及2018年類比，讓人想起今年被喊出的10個黑色星期一。聯準會背景相似，央行/行政部門在中期選舉聚焦可負擔性後肯定希望市場降溫以產生財富效應。並未排除，特別是如果聯準會瘋狂到降50基點就知道他們認真了。但如果只降25基點如定價且增長背景仍不錯，仍認為12月下半月正面。下週也設定得相當不錯有些上漲空間。

en.text: Everyone on X mentioning 2018 analogues, reminding of 10 black Mondays called this year. Fed backdrop similar, central banks/admin want market to cool for wealth effect after midterms focused on affordability. Not ruling out, especially if Fed goes 50bps then serious. But if only 25bps as priced and growth decent, still thinks second half of December positive. Next week setting up for some upside.

zh.text: Cullen Roche 解釋基本銀行會計：存款對持有人是資產、對銀行是負債；準備金是銀行資產、聯準會僅對銀行的負債，並非對存款人。個人無法持有準備金，只有銀行可以。提領現金是持有聯準會負債的唯一方式。

en.text: Cullen Roche explains basic bank accounting: deposits are assets for holders and liabilities for banks; reserves are bank assets and Fed liabilities to banks only, not to depositors. Individuals cannot hold reserves; only banks can. Cash withdrawal is the sole way to hold a Fed liability.
